Insert bounded reporting helper functions before the unchanged waitFor function
Call reportStartupFailure after the original failure.json write and before the original throw

followupFromInitialCandidate.change: Both command and process ISO-time selectors now require canonical Date round-trip equality; no other candidate bytes changed

triggeringEvidence.basis: Completed original log independently matched by root and the AppKit owner; source control flow independently inspected
triggeringEvidence.firstFailure: Native driver response timed out awaiting tron.window (request 2)
triggeringEvidence.controlFlowBoundary: The verifier had not reached mounted('root-main') or allocated tooltipEvidence. This does not establish that React content never mounted.

appLog.range: prefix up to the source size observed at open, limited to one MiB
appLog.sha256Scope: exact bytes retained in the read-time prefix snapshot

perStream.recordSelection: first sixteen and last sixteen matching records within the scanned prefix, without duplicate indexes

reporting.traceBinding: Only the two fixed NSLog prefixes with the exact owned PID in the native log header are accepted
reporting.activationFields: Fixed phases, local operation, epoch time, main-thread Boolean and typed policy/window/callback/identity fields
reporting.transportFields: Fixed phases/commands, local sequence, epoch time, main-thread Boolean and selected Boolean/byte/error-code fields
reporting.commandFields: Fixed phases/commands, ISO time, safe numeric request/response IDs and typed ok/protocol values
reporting.processFields: Owned PID, observation times, nullable exit status with availability, fixed signal names, sampler timings/thread count/typed hasThreadStacks and validated producer-recorded sample digest

authorChecks.scope: V8 source selectors and mocked bounded filesystem/console only; no Node filesystem, macOS or native acceptance execution

checks.name: strict typed selectors and fixed vocabulary
canonical ISO validators reject normalized invalid calendar dates
nested activation state and transport classifications
owned NSLog PID and complete line parsing
process projection PID, unknown status and sampler digest scope
exact original digests, retained snapshot and no secret console content
live append preserves bounded initial prefix and labels change
source replacement remains a captured descriptor snapshot
wx collision preserves prior bytes and does not claim a fresh snapshot
missing inputs remain explicit unavailable observations
invalid JSON and invalid typed observations remain distinct
hard read caps and overflow never publish a complete partial hash
changing command and process files cannot receive complete-file digests
exact complete-file cap accepts only the full EOF-terminated read
line scan and record retention budgets disclose omissions
complete 32 KiB envelope trims records while retaining latest stages
all new IO/reporting failures preserve primary error and cleanup
empty originals differ from missing originals
authentic historical timeout and late-send records stay separate

publication.authorActions: immutable candidate, reproducible check and source-review blobs only

sourceJob.basis: workflow metadata independently observed by root; complete original log retrieval pending

publication.receiptBoundary: Published source checkpoint; workflow completion metadata does not substitute for original log review or native interactions

preparedHelper.status: published source checkpoint; actual native runtime outcome remains unobserved at this receipt checkpoint
